name: Nika — Promote Sent Lines to Processed (nightly)

nodes.name: Every Night at Midnight
nodes.notes: Midnight LJUBLJANA time, not UTC — the workflow's own timezone setting (Europe/Ljubljana) is what the schedule is read in, and it is the same clock the app shows every timestamp on.

nodes.name: Live Catalog Lines
nodes.notes: Main + Other only — the 25k frozen Processed rows are never loaded. Safe as a filter because catalog_lines.catalog is NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main' (add-catalog-column.sql), so no row can slip past a neq test by being null. "sent_at is not null" cannot be expressed here — the node offers `is` but no `not.is` — so that test lives in the code node.

nodes.name: Move to Processed
nodes.notes: `id` is the filter, so it is excluded from the body: the only column written is catalog = 'processed'. Same node shape as 'Update Catalog Line' in the extraction workflow.
